reviewType: Independent full translation review against accepted Russian, not author self-review
scopeLimit: Read the complete publication JSON in all three languages, including metadata, source notes, limitations and illustration text. Translation fidelity reviewed against accepted RU; no new claim of separately reading every historical source.
findings: Read the full title/dek, all five sections and fourteen paragraphs, all three limitations, both complete source records, and image caption/credit in English and Chinese against accepted RU. Both translations preserve the narrative from grain collateral and trusted borrowers through deposits, risk and wartime controls.

The grain firms’support for creditors is retained without conflating every firm named Yifahe with a single legal entity. Railway consignment security, property pledged to banks and overdraft operation remain distinct.

Two jiao per thousand yuan per day equals0.2yuan, with no annual conversion or claim of citywide average interest. The1931table retains300000banknote yuan and1923opening date; different currencies are not added together.
Prize scheme retains monthly3yuan, top prize30000and unknown winner name/year. The1935directory is identified as cited rather than separately read. Publication date1988belongs only to volume6.
Both translations correctly render inclusive permission thresholds: industrial100000or more, commercial50000or more, overdraft30000or more; eight cash houses by1944remain attributed to the account.

Sun’s role in both accounts and Huang’srecording/editing prevent presenting them as fully independent sources. The gold/silver dispute has no invented year; silver-system notes are not mistaken for metal coins.
The photograph remains Yokohama Specie Bank, explicitly not Sun’sLongkou workplace. The compiler is not identified as photographer. Unknown photograph date is preserved.
English and Chinese are independently readable and preserve source attribution and uncertainty. No mandatory translation corrections found.
